input.summary: Extend the Auction Platform licence to AP Affiliates and contractors acting on AP's behalf, and make it revocable only on expiration/termination rather than at Kubient's discretion.
input.comment: [Playbook] We have extended the licence to our Affiliates and to contractors acting on our behalf, and removed the at-will "revocable" language so the licence ends only on expiration or termination of the Agreement under Section 4. Our playbook does not accept a licence revocable at the vendor's discretion or one that excludes affiliates and contractors; as a fallback we can cover Affiliates on written notice to Kubient.

ops.oldText: Kubient hereby grants to Customer a limited, royalty-free, non-exclusive, non-transferable, non-assignable, without right of sublicense, revocable license to access, participate in and use to the full extent the Auction Platform as hosted by Kubient, for the purpose of serving Inventory at Target Demand (" ").
ops.newText: Kubient hereby grants to Customer, its Affiliates (meaning any entity that controls, is controlled by, or is under common control with Customer) and contractors acting on Customer's behalf a limited, royalty-free, non-exclusive, non-transferable (except in connection with an assignment of this Agreement permitted hereunder), without right of further sublicense, license, revocable only upon expiration or termination of this Agreement in accordance with Section 4, to access, participate in and use to the full extent the Auction Platform as hosted by Kubient, for the purpose of serving Inventory at Target Demand (" "). Access to and use of the Auction Platform by such Affiliates and contractors shall not constitute prohibited third-party access, and Customer shall remain responsible for their compliance with this Agreement.
